newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt interbank rates fall in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt interbank rates fall in liquid market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Tuesday in a liquid private-sector market to between 8-1/2 and 8-3/4 percent from 8-5/8 and 9-1/8 percent on Monday, bankers said.
"The market is liquid because it's almost the end of the week," one banker said.
Wednesday is a public holiday marking Revolution day and most bankers expect very quiet trade on Thursday. The market is typically liquid at the end of the working week.
One-week rates were also slightly down at between 8-1/2 and 8-5/8 percent from 8-3/4 and nine percent, they added.
